## Source and licence

## Checklist

- [ ] Licence allows redistribution and is recorded in `license`; `source.url` and `source.retrieved` filled in for third-party material
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes with no errors
- [ ] Filed per the decision guide in CONTRIBUTING.md (jurisdiction / category / subcategory / type / variant)
- [ ] Filename follows docs/naming.md
- [ ] Body is the publisher's text as published: nothing added, nothing removed, every notice and credit line kept
- [ ] `npm run build` run and every regenerated file committed (catalog, attribution, llms files, schema and the folder README files under `templates/`)
